title: Cosmetic manifest
description: Tells the Monopsony client how to render a cosmetic item. Mirrors server/internal/cosmetics/manifest.go, which is the validator of record.

builtin.description: A look shipped with the client, e.g. token.pawn, board.midnight, dice.onyx.

color.description: Tint for builtin shapes and glTF materials not marked keep_*. Omit to use the seat colour.

model.description: A glTF 2.0 model (.glb). Either url (uploaded asset or https) or builtin (bundled with the client).

palette.description: Colours for board / dice / cards items. Allowed keys depend on the slot: board (table, tile, tileEdge, text, centre, house, hotel, mortgageTint), dice (body, pip), cards (back, face).

preview.description: Optional image shown in the shop instead of the live 3D preview.
